title: Trace sparse changes through an event-driven network
description: Change the signal, encoder, activity, and firing threshold. The event stream, router pressure, membrane state, and output spikes update together.

scenarios.label: Quiet vibration sensor
scenarios.detail: Long idle periods with a short mechanical transient.

scenarios.label: Intermittent event-camera motion
scenarios.detail: Several localized changes separated by quieter intervals.

scenarios.label: Continuous textured motion
scenarios.detail: Most channels change repeatedly, so temporal sparsity is weak.

encoders.label: Latency code
encoders.detail: Represent each detected feature with a small timed spike packet.

encoders.label: Rate code
encoders.detail: Repeat spikes over a time window; robust, but less sparse.
